After Kh6, White plays fxe5 winning the queen. After Kxh5, White can play fxe5 or Bf7+. Either way, after f4+, Black loses the queen. This is clearly the best move!

**Best move:** f4+

**Main line:** f4+ Qxf4 (forced, or lose the queen immediately) Nxf4+ and White has won the queen.

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**
Your knight and pawn created a fork trap. When you played f4+, checking the king and attacking the queen simultaneously, Black couldn't save both. The queen had to move or be captured; if it recaptured on f4, your knight captured it. Always look for moves that attack multiple pieces at once—especially the opponent's queen. This double threat (fork) is one of the strongest tactical patterns.
